sourceScan.screeningDepth: All 100 titles and available summary previews screened. Selected supporting pages separately researched. This is not a claim that 100 full articles were read or independently fact-checked.
sourceScan.knownLimitation: A general-news section contributes many politics/sports items; collector category is a feed label, not item-level relevance.

editorialSelection.rationale: Current rail announcements create a useful planning theme. A station-and-booking checklist addresses international visitor decisions without mistaking future network projects or domestic entitlement changes for present services. Evergreen synthesis, not a report that these announcements changed Istanbul–Ankara operations.
editorialSelection.overlapDecision: Existing articles address urban lines, etiquette, city scheduling and business travel. New article concerns an intercity ticket, exact station names, whole-journey comparison and booking records.

editorialSelection.rationale: Museum and opening/night-session signals make admission-product verification useful. Selected a durable coverage-ledger calculation instead of repeating unverified new-venue coverage or hard-coded fares. Evergreen synthesis supported by current ministry product pages; not a breaking-news opening claim.
editorialSelection.overlapDecision: Existing pages give site context, sightseeing order and broad digital-ticketing discussion. New page focuses on one purchase decision with confirmed coverage and a symbolic calculation.

editorialSelection.rationale: More cultural visits and entitlement-related transport news highlight the need to separate admission eligibility from a suitable physical route. Chosen as a practical access-contact framework, with venue-owned evidence, without applying Turkish citizen rail benefits to foreign visitors or claiming new venue facilities.
editorialSelection.overlapDecision: Corpus references accessibility only generally. This article supplies a continuous-route question set, sensory/rest requirements, documentation check and workable alternatives; it is not a medical or on-site access assessment.

notSelected.reason: Medical/outbreak or individual-health claims are sensitive and need a distinct verification workflow; do not turn general health headlines into travel reassurance or advice.
Politics, sport, security or unrelated incidents do not answer the selected ITO visitor-planning intents. Feed category labels alone are not relevance evidence.
Mostly non-Türkiye destinations, supplier announcements, trade events or speculative promotion; insufficient relevance to immediate ITO visitor decisions.
Investment, law, hotel-industry data, accidents or projects require separate sourcing; do not assume a planned hotel/beach is an available visitor product.

Potential later research or background. Not selected for this first batch because user-facing practical value, overlap, fresh primary corroboration or topic specificity was weaker than the three chosen intents.

corpusReview.method: Editorial comparison of the entire legacy slug/title/excerpt inventory, retrieval of relevant body contexts, then reading the closest EN article bodies. This is a manual semantic-intent review, not an embedding-model similarity result.
corpusReview.remainingReview: Root independent review. No keyword scan alone is represented as complete semantic review.

localization.coverage: Full practical sections and caveats preserved. Chinese and Korean retain Turkish station names, do not assume home-country rail rules or disability-document reciprocity, and link to same-batch local articles. German uses existing German routes. Spanish labels English fallback links where a Spanish legacy translation does not exist.
localization.reviewType: AI agent editorial adaptation/review; no native-speaker, human expert, site visit or accessibility certification claimed.
localization.sameBatchLinkDependency: Localized new-to-new links must be published as the complete three-topic batch, or repointed before partial publication.
localization.independentReview: DE/ES six variants independently compared against EN master by initial_editorial_batch agent on 2026-10-24; all sections, caveats, sources and link-language fallbacks checked. One literal German route-planning sentence corrected. No human/native-speaker certification claimed. EN/zh-CN/KO author self-review complete; root review remains required.
